novcanik.skener_opis: Scan the recipient's QR code to re-register POEN to them.
novcanik.skener_uputstvo: Point the camera at the QR code of the person you are re-registering POEN to.
novcanik.skener_greska_qr: Invalid QR code. Scan a KOLO QR code for re-registration.
novcanik.send_napomena: A re-registration creates no new POEN: your record decreases by exactly what theirs increases.
novcanik.send_greska_iznos: Amount must be a positive integer.
novcanik.send_uspeh_opis: {iznos} POEN has been re-registered into the record of @{pseudonim}.
novcanik.qr_opis: Show this code to someone re-registering POEN to you — they scan it with their phone.
novcanik.opis_stranice: Your POEN record — how much has been recorded for you and everything that has happened. POEN records your contribution; it is not money and is not exchanged for dinars. From here you can re-register POEN to another member.
novcanik.prazno_naslov: You don't have any POEN recorded yet.
novcanik.prazno_opis: POEN is recorded through community participation — through confirmation, exchanging goods and services, or making contributions. Start by getting confirmed.
novcanik.zabelezen_opis: It is recorded when the Foundation approves your first listing, when someone confirms you, or when someone re-registers POEN to you. Until then it is only noted — not yet part of your record.
novcanik.samo_primalac: While you are a new member, POEN can be re-registered into your record. Re-registering into someone else's record opens up once you are confirmed.
novcanik.nadoknada_opis: It arose from cancelling a record that was not covered — a cancelled confirmation you gave, or a re-registration cancelled after a report about an exchange. It is not a debt and cannot be collected — POEN recorded or re-registered to you fills it first. Exchanging goods and services is not restricted for you; re-registering POEN to someone else is possible once your record passes zero.
novcanik.putanja_opis: Five steps, 1,000 POEN each. They unlock in order, and at most 5,000 POEN is recorded per member in total.
novcanik.putanja_korak_1: First listing offering a good or a service that meets the content minimum
novcanik.putanja_korak_2: The first exchange in which you re-register POEN to a member outside your chain
novcanik.putanja_korak_3: Three listings, two of which received an enquiry from different members
novcanik.putanja_korak_4: Exchanges with 5 different people outside your chain
novcanik.putanja_korak_5: Exchanges with 10 different people outside your chain
novcanik.putanja_zabelezen: Noted — the record follows approval or confirmation
novcanik.putanja_pravila: The counter includes re-registrations of at least 1,000 POEN with people outside your chain of confirmations. Each counterpart counts once, no matter how many re-registrations. A re-registration with a member nobody has confirmed yet is noted, but counts only once they are confirmed. Currently in the counter: {sagovornika}.
novcanik.prijavi_dugme: Report a problem with this exchange
novcanik.prijavi_opis: If you re-registered POEN and did not receive what was agreed, tell the Foundation. The re-registration is not reversed on its own — the Foundation decides; if it annuls it, the whole amount comes back to you, even when that pushes the other side's ledger below zero.
novcanik.prijavi_placeholder: What was agreed and what happened.
novcanik.prijavi_ceka: Report sent — awaiting the Foundation's decision.
novcanik.prijavi_ponistena: The re-registration was annulled upon the report.
novcanik.prijavi_odbacena: The report was reviewed — the re-registration stands.
novcanik.ceka_roditelja: The account is waiting for a parent to take it over. Until then POEN can be re-registered into your record; re-registering to others unlocks once a parent takes the account over.
novcanik.nadoknada_opis_dete: This came off when a friendship ended. The first POEN that arrives fills it in. Everything else works as usual.
novcanik.rezervisano_nabavka_opis: Reserved until the goods are collected. Annulled upon collection, not before; if you do not collect, it returns to your record.

donacije.vidljivost_anonimna_opis: Your name is not shown. No POEN is recorded for an anonymous donation.

landing.meta_desc: KOLO is a network for exchanging work, goods and knowledge — what some have is what others need.
landing.hero_naslov: An exchange network you build in your own community
landing.hero_podnaslov: Work, goods and knowledge circulate among people in Sombor and the surrounding area — no middlemen, no money.
landing.hero_badge: Your local marketplace — paid in contribution, not money
landing.problem_1_naslov: Food travels, while it grows right next to us.
landing.problem_1_opis: We buy honey, eggs, cheese and vegetables that have crossed thousands of kilometres, while someone in the neighbourhood produces exactly that.
landing.problem_1_poenta: What we need grows right next to us, yet never reaches us.
landing.problem_2_naslov: The producer has no one to sell to.
landing.problem_2_opis: What's left is a buyer who dictates the price, or a market stall you stand at all day. A small producer can't break into the big chains: they are shut out of them, and we are shut inside them.
landing.problem_2_poenta: The demand exists, the supply exists, the channel doesn't.
landing.problem_3_opis: The neighbour is a skilled tradesman, the woman next door makes the best cheese around, their son gives lessons. And only the people closest to them know it.
landing.problem_3_poenta: What we need every day, no one brings together in one place.
landing.alternativa_naslov: KOLO is a well we dig together
landing.alternativa_citat:
When people were thirsty, together they dug a well.
Everyone drank from it, and no one was thirsty any more.
The well was no one's property, yet it was everyone's care: they agreed how it would be used and maintained it themselves.
That is why it lasted.
landing.alternativa_podnaslov: KOLO is that well. You do not draw water from it — you exchange what people can do and what they have.
landing.alternativa_1_opis: A neighbour, a friend, a friend of a friend, and then someone from the next village you don't know yet. What some have is what others need, and that is exactly what brings them together. Every exchange is one connection that did not exist before.
landing.alternativa_2_opis_start: Every time you give someone in the network work, goods or knowledge, it is recorded. That record is called a
landing.alternativa_2_opis_end: , the network's unit of account. It is not money, it is not exchanged for dinars, it is not traded on any market. A POEN shows what you have given to the community, and that is how people come to know you.
landing.alternativa_3_naslov: The rules are the same for everyone
landing.alternativa_3_opis: The rules of the system and the way decisions are made are written down and anyone can read them. They are not changed in favour of an individual, but together and by the same procedure for everyone. Shared resources are governed by the community itself, not by someone on the outside.
landing.kome_1_opis: Your produce goes straight to the people looking for it, with no middleman and no markup.
landing.kome_1_poenta: Every bit of your effort is recorded and seen.
landing.kome_2_opis: People where you live see what you do and recommend you for work you have actually done.
landing.kome_2_poenta: Do one job well, and the whole neighbourhood knows.
landing.kome_3_opis: You know how to repair, advise, teach. What you give is recorded, so later it is easier to get what you need.
landing.kome_3_poenta: Your experience becomes visible and sought after.
landing.kome_4_opis: Preserves, baking, handmade goods — everything made at home has someone nearby looking for it.
landing.kome_4_poenta: Work done at home becomes visible as a contribution to the community.
landing.kome_5_opis: Childcare, healthy food, a hand around the house — from people you know, or people known to someone you trust.
landing.kome_5_poenta: You don't have to manage alone, because we are here for each other.
landing.kome_6_naslov: Young people and those just starting out
landing.kome_6_opis: Your first people to work for, and room to show what you can do. You need neither capital nor a company, just someone to give you the first chance.
landing.kome_6_poenta: A reason to stay here, and a place you can shape.
landing.kome_7_naslov: People who care about their own area
landing.kome_7_opis: When you exchange with someone nearby, the value stays in the area instead of going somewhere far away.
landing.kome_7_poenta: Every exchange in your neighbourhood is one more connection in the network.
landing.kome_8_opis: You are already organised and you already have people. KOLO adds a record of exchange and a link to other cooperatives and individuals.
landing.kome_8_poenta: Your members join the whole network, and you gain a tool for your work.
landing.kome_9_opis: The code is open under AGPL-3.0, the content under CC BY-SA 4.0. You can check how the system works and propose changes.
landing.kome_9_poenta: A project you can trust because you can read it.
landing.primer_korak_1_naslov: Ana and Milan meet through an exchange
landing.primer_korak_1_opis: Milan needs honey, Ana produces it. She normally sells a jar for 800 dinars, so they agreed that five jars are worth 4,000 POEN — and that is what Milan re-registered to her.
landing.primer_korak_2_opis: Ana's washing machine broke down. Lazar repaired it, and Ana re-registered 4,000 POEN to him. She paid nothing in money, and Lazar now has a record of his work.
landing.primer_korak_3_opis: Lazar felt like having burek. Marija baked him a tray of it, he re-registered 800 POEN to her, and she used them for a jar of Ana's honey.
landing.primer_most: At the start they did not know one another. Now they are in the same circle.
landing.primer_napomena_1: It is a record of what each person has given to the community.
landing.primer_napomena_2: The honey, the repair and the burek in this example are real. The amount in POEN is proposed by whoever posts the listing and agreed between the two sides. A price in dinars only serves as a reference point for that agreement. POEN is not bought for money and is not exchanged for money.
landing.kako_funkcionise_link_postupak: The whole process, step by step
landing.kako_funkcionise_korak_1_opis: Free, and it takes about a minute. You choose a nickname instead of your real name, and no documents are needed.
landing.kako_funkcionise_korak_2_opis: You can post your first three listings straight away, without a single confirmation. That is how people where you live get to see you.
landing.kako_funkcionise_korak_3_opis: Someone who knows you personally confirms that you are a real person. Both of you thereby enter the chain of confirmations, and 1,000 POEN is recorded for each of you.
landing.kako_funkcionise_korak_3_dodatak: Don't know anyone in KOLO yet? Exchange with someone first, and let the person you exchanged with confirm you.

landing.ko_stoji_opis: For fifteen years he has followed how communities in Switzerland, Italy, Canada and Japan exchange work, goods and knowledge without money — and which of those arrangements have lasted for decades.
landing.ko_stoji_opis_2: KOLO is our version of the social and solidarity economy, adapted to Serbian law. It is an approach in which people organise themselves to care for one another, and both the United Nations and the European Union have recognised it as an equal part of the economy.
landing.ko_stoji_citat: “Every day in my surgery I see people the system ought to help but can't. Everyone has something to contribute. All they need is a tool and people around them.”

oNama.meta_title: KOLO Foundation — how the system came about and where it stands
oNama.meta_desc: The KOLO Foundation was entered in the register in July 2026, and the platform is in testing with real users. How the system came about, what stage of development it is in, and how you can take part.
oNama.hero_opis: The Foundation was entered in the Register of Endowments and Foundations in July 2026. The platform is running and now in testing, with real people and real exchange. This page covers how the system came about, what stage of development it is in and how you take part.
oNama.citat_tekst: As a doctor, my calling is to help people. I believe the society we live in is arranged for the same reason. Every day in my surgery I see people the system ought to help but cannot. Farmers, pensioners, mothers, people who are ill and who still have a great deal to give. Everyone has their place in society and something to contribute. All they need is the infrastructure — the tools and a community behind them.
oNama.prica_p1: The first doubt came back at medical school. I saw how far the incentives in the profession — from the pharmaceutical industry to the way it is funded — and regulatory policy push medicine towards treating consequences rather than preserving health. I later recognised the same logic in food production, in the economy and in the labour market. I finished medicine because I concluded that a system is easier to change from within.
oNama.prica_p2: Alongside medicine I spent years studying complementary economic systems — networks in which people exchange work and goods without money as an intermediary. In March 2014 I was a guest on the programme Na rubu znanosti on Croatian public television, in the episode on alternative currencies, where I presented ALVA, the project's form at the time. In June 2016 I spent a week on Pelion in Greece, at the Innovation in Exchange and Finance workshop at the Kalikalos school, led by Thomas Greco, author of The End of Money and the Future of Civilization and one of the best-known theorists of complementary currencies in the world.
oNama.prica_p2b: The group also included the team from Volos, who ran Volos TEM, a Greek exchange network born at the height of the debt crisis. People there exchange food, services and craft goods at markets of their own, recording value instead of paying it. At its best the network had more than 800 members. I put the same subjects forward at home too, at public talks in Stanišić, Sombor, Novi Sad and Belgrade.
oNama.prica_p3: Over the years the idea changed name and form: ALVA in 2012, Transition Alternative in 2013, the Alva Foundation in 2016. Today it is KOLO. After fifteen years we have finished documentation, a registered Foundation and a platform that works. The structure is set up so that in time it runs ever more independently of any one person, myself included.
oNama.status_opis: The system is being built in phases. The first is behind us; we are in the second now.
oNama.faza1_opis: Platform built, documentation written, Foundation registered. (Behind us.)
oNama.faza2_opis: Real users check the whole flow under real conditions: registration, proof of reality, POEN, the Marketplace and the programmes.
oNama.faza3_opis: Public registration opens. The goal is to reach enough confirmed people for exchange and mutuality in the first community to sustain themselves.
oNama.faza4_opis: All modules are running, including cooperatives and support programmes, and shared decision-making goes through the Upper Kolo. The community governs the system itself.
oNama.faza5_opis: Cooperatives are founded in several cities and connected into a network. KOLO is no longer tied to a single place.
oNama.faza6_opis: KOLO rests entirely on existing law. In this phase the model also gains a formally recognised place in the legal framework, through legislation and a clear positioning of the model.
oNama.faza7_opis: Through mutual aid the community itself carries what is today left to institutions or to no one: security when it is needed, care for the ill and the elderly, the passing on of knowledge, food production, mutual financing and shared decision-making.
oNama.otvaranje_opis: We are checking the whole flow in practice, with real people and real exchange. Nothing here is a simulation.
oNama.stavka1_tekst: The whole path a user goes through: registration, proof of reality through the chain, recording, re-registering and writing off POEN, the Marketplace, the programmes and donations.
oNama.stavka2_tekst: We check that every record holds: the balance of accounts, the nightly calculations and the record of contributions. The aim is for the figures to be right down to the last POEN.
oNama.stavka3_tekst: We look for mistakes and possible abuse now, while the network is small and the damage would be small. That is the only moment when it can be done cheaply.
oNama.stavka4_tekst: Everything you enter stays. Your account, your POEN, the contributions recorded and the history of your exchanges carry over into the next phase. This testing is not a trial run that gets wiped.
oNama.stavka5_tekst: When the platform is stable and the whole flow runs without errors, we move into Critical mass and open public registration. The opening does not depend on the number of POEN; that threshold comes later, with the Upper Kolo.
oNama.stavka6_tekst: The KOLO Foundation is entered in the Register of Endowments and Foundations at the Serbian Business Registers Agency, with its seat in Sombor. The registration details are further down this page.

oSistemu.meta_title: Where KOLO comes from — solidarity economy in practice
oSistemu.meta_desc: Systems in which people exchange work, goods and knowledge through a ledger of their own have been running in Switzerland since 1934, in Canada since 1983, in Sardinia and in Japan. KOLO belongs to that family.
oSistemu.hero_opis: What KOLO is, how it is set up, and which tradition it comes from.
oSistemu.zajednicko_citat: “Grain by grain, a loaf; stone by stone, a palace.”
oSistemu.zajednicko_p1: Acquaintances, work, knowledge, goods, time and the infrastructure the Foundation maintains all pass through KOLO. All of it leaves a trace: it strengthens the network, the knowledge and the trust, and those remain available to everyone. The community thereby becomes more capable of caring for itself.
oSistemu.zajednicko_p2_post: . It is no one's property, yet it is everyone's care: the rules are shared, and it is maintained by those who use it.
oSistemu.zajednicko_p3_pre: is a record of your contribution to the common good. An acknowledgement that you brought something, and the mark by which others in the network know you.
oSistemu.svg_cuva_ime: which the Foundation holds and, under the Statute, uses for the community
oSistemu.svg_svi_zajedno: all users together form the KOLO Community
oSistemu.svg_nosioci_odlucuju: ZRNO Holders decide through the Upper Kolo
oSistemu.svg_zerosum: · the sum of all records is zero
oSistemu.k1_tekst: Everyone who has accepted KOLO's rules. Through their work, goods and knowledge they contribute to the common good, and that is recorded for them in POEN. Whoever holds ZRNO also takes part in decisions through the Upper Kolo.
oSistemu.k2_tekst: It is made up of all ZRNO holders, and its composition changes every day. It decides by quadratic voting: the number of votes is the square root of the number of active ZRNO, so someone with a hundred ZRNO has ten votes. That is what keeps power from ending up with a handful of people.
oSistemu.k3_podnaslov: the software that keeps the record
oSistemu.k3_tekst: It is open under AGPL-3.0, which means anyone may read, use and improve it, while changes must stay equally open. The Foundation maintains and runs it. It records POEN and keeps the ledger under rules that are set in advance, public and the same for everyone. With every POEN recorded it records the same amount against itself as a minus, so the sum of all records stays zero.
oSistemu.k4_podnaslov: the legal entity behind the system
oSistemu.k4_tekst: A foundation registered in Sombor. It receives donations and patronage in dinars, goods and services, covers the cost of running the system, holds the infrastructure and represents KOLO before the community and the state. The Statute and the Rulebook bind it to use all of that for the common good.
oSistemu.topla_voda_tag: We are not reinventing the wheel
oSistemu.topla_voda_naslov: This already works elsewhere, and has for decades
oSistemu.topla_voda_p1: The idea that a community can organise its own exchange is not new. Nor is it exotic. In various countries people have for decades been exchanging work, goods and knowledge through ledgers of their own, with a unit that is not money yet makes exchange within the network possible.
oSistemu.topla_voda_p2_post: , and it covers cooperatives, foundations and mutual societies — organisations that work for a social purpose, decide democratically and return value to the community. The field has been formally recognised by the International Labour Organization, the United Nations General Assembly, and the Council and the Commission of the European Union.
oSistemu.topla_voda_p3: KOLO is one attempt within that field, adapted to Serbian law and to the needs here. It does not present itself as a finished product: the rules change through participation and democratic procedure, and they will keep changing as the network grows.
oSistemu.sistemi_opis: Four networks from different parts of the world. Different countries, different contexts — but the same family of systems. KOLO belongs to that family, with its own distinctive features.
oSistemu.sistemi_wir_opis: The oldest system of its kind still running today. Founded in 1934, at the height of the Great Depression, as a mutual credit network among businesses. Every member starts from zero and repays by selling to other members. The WIR franc is not exchanged for Swiss francs. Today more than fifty thousand Swiss small and medium businesses trade within the network.
oSistemu.sistemi_wir_pokazao: A mutual credit network can last ninety years and be countercyclical. When the official economy weakens, trade within WIR grows.
oSistemu.sistemi_lets_opis: In the early eighties, in a small town on Vancouver Island, Michael Linton started the first Local Exchange Trading System — a local network in which members exchange work, goods and services using a ledger unit of their own, unconnected to the national currency. A typical LETS network gathers anywhere from a few dozen to a few hundred people, and the sum of all accounts is always zero. In Britain there were five such networks in 1992, and about 350 three years later, with tens of thousands of members.
oSistemu.sistemi_lets_pokazao: The model spreads fast and needs no expensive technology. But it also showed the limit: networks that stay small and go unused day to day fade away in time. Durability does not come from the idea, but from how often it is used.
oSistemu.sistemi_sardex_opis: Started in 2010 as a response to the debt crisis that hit Sardinia hard. A group of young Sardinians, with little experience in finance or business but a clear grasp of their region's problem, built a mutual credit network among local companies. Every member starts from zero, the sum of all accounts is always zero, and there is no interest.
oSistemu.sistemi_sardex_pokazao: A local team, with no large investment and no state support, can build a durable network in about ten years — given persistence, structure, and an understanding of the real problems of the place.
oSistemu.sistemi_fureai_opis: A Japanese exchange system based on time and care for the elderly. Members who help older people — through home care, accompaniment, cooking — log the hours worked and can use them for themselves or transfer them to a family member elsewhere in the country who cares for their own parent. It grew into hundreds of organisations with around a hundred thousand users across Japan, operating in parallel with the state care system for years.
oSistemu.sistemi_fureai_pokazao: A contribution ledger can become the infrastructure of care for vulnerable groups in society. Recognising care work as economically measurable does not degrade its human character — on the contrary, it makes it visible and transferable.
oSistemu.familija_naslov: The same family, with its own distinctive features
oSistemu.familija_p1: KOLO is not a copy of any of those networks. They built a unit for exchange. KOLO builds a record of contribution, and exchange is what follows from it.
oSistemu.familija_p2: What those networks do not have is a chain of confirmations. In KOLO the reality of every member is confirmed by someone who knows them personally and answers for it. That is what keeps the network real.
oSistemu.familija_p3_pre: The second difference is that contribution and voice are not mixed.
oSistemu.familija_p3_zrno: carries the vote in decisions, with quadratic voting that keeps power from ending up with a handful of people. Support for mothers, the elderly and pupils is not an add-on but part of the system.
oSistemu.familija_p4: The third difference is what rests on what. What you agree and hand over to each other is the exchange. POEN is only a record of it. A record on its own obliges no one to anything.
oSistemu.familija_p5: There are also differences that are easy to check. WIR obtained a banking licence in 1936 because it lends to its members, while KOLO does not lend. Sardex is a company that charges an annual membership fee, while entering KOLO is free. Neither of those approaches is wrong — they are answers to a different problem.
oSistemu.familija_p6: With all of that, KOLO belongs to the same family: systems that record exchange between people, run alongside official money, and work for their users instead of using them.
oSistemu.okvir_opis: In recent years the social and solidarity economy has gained what it lacked for decades: an agreed definition, a United Nations resolution and a European Union action plan. None of them mentions KOLO, and KOLO did not come out of them. These documents describe a field that fits KOLO — and it is the field Serbia is taking on through accession.
oSistemu.okvir1_naslov: European Union · Social Economy Action Plan
oSistemu.okvir1_tekst: A plan with 63 actions and a horizon to 2030. It defines the social economy through three features: the primacy of people and of social or environmental purpose over profit, the reinvestment of most profits and surpluses in the collective or general interest, and democratic or participatory governance. Among the models it names platform cooperatives, and among the measures the strengthening of grassroots initiatives.
oSistemu.okvir2_naslov: International Labour Organization · Resolution on decent work and the social and solidarity economy
oSistemu.okvir2_tekst: The first internationally agreed definition, adopted tripartitely by governments, employers and trade unions from 187 states. Alongside democratic governance and the primacy of people over capital, it names voluntary cooperation, mutual aid and autonomy.
oSistemu.okvir3_naslov: United Nations · General Assembly, Resolution A/RES/77/281
oSistemu.okvir3_tekst: The first General Assembly resolution on this field. It calls on states to develop legal and financial frameworks for it. The series continued with a resolution in 2024.
oSistemu.okvir4_naslov: European Union · Council Recommendation on the conditions for the social economy to thrive
oSistemu.okvir4_tekst: An elaboration of the Action Plan. It calls on member states to adopt national strategies, and among the priorities it names short food supply chains.
oSistemu.pristup_tekst_pre: Serbia is negotiating accession, so this framework concerns it too — formally through
oSistemu.pristup_tekst_bold: chapter 19, social policy and employment, and chapter 22, regional policy
oSistemu.pristup_tekst_post: . None of these documents is a binding regulation. They are definitions, recommendations and plans, and their value lies in showing which way things are going.
oSistemu.prema_p1: KOLO is not at the start of that road. The features from both definitions are already built into how the system works; they are not goals still to be reached.
oSistemu.prema_p2: The rules are decided by ZRNO holders, through quadratic voting, and the rules are public and change by the same procedure for everyone. The Foundation distributes no profit and returns everything to the system. POEN is not an object of trade. Participation is voluntary, and support for mothers, the elderly and pupils is built into the mechanism itself. The software is open under AGPL-3.0, so anyone can check how it works.
oSistemu.prema_p3: This is not an endorsement from anyone. It means there is a yardstick against which KOLO can be checked.
oSistemu.zasto_p1: Bačka has one of the oldest cooperative traditions in Europe. The Gazdovský spolok, founded in 1846 in Bački Petrovac, two years after the Rochdale cooperative in England, is still cited among the first cooperatives in the world. Cooperatives, homesteads, lending a hand in the fields: this is not history that needs explaining here — older people in the villages around Sombor remember it first-hand. KOLO does not introduce a new form of organising, but the one that used to be ordinary in these parts.
oSistemu.zasto_p2: Sombor is large enough for the effects of a network to show, and small enough to see who is producing them. A town ringed by homesteads and villages means the craftsman, the pensioner, the housewife, the young mother and the farmer are all in the same place. It also means that those of us building this live here, so whatever does not work is not something we can fail to notice.
oSistemu.zasto_citat: One hand washes the other, and both wash the face.
oSistemu.cta_opis: Now that you know where the system comes from,
oSistemu.cta_opis2: what is left is to see how it works.

pravnaPozicija.meta_desc: What POEN and ZRNO are not under Serbian law, why there is no conversion into dinars, and which rules the system stands on. With the governing provisions.
pravnaPozicija.hero_opis: How KOLO is qualified under Serbian law, and why. The provisions each statement rests on are cited alongside it.
pravnaPozicija.uvod: The KOLO system is not a payment institution, an issuer of digital assets, a collective investment scheme or an employer (Rulebook art. 69). That qualification does not rest on a declaration but on the structure of the system — on what POEN and ZRNO are, how they come about, and what cannot be done with them.
pravnaPozicija.poen_uvod: POEN is an internal unit of account that records contribution. It has no holder and exists solely as an entry in the Protocol's ledger (art. 12–13). It follows that it is not:
pravnaPozicija.zrno_uvod: ZRNO is an internal unit of account that records a user's standing, from which a vote in the Upper Circle follows. The Rulebook qualifies it explicitly (art. 18):
pravnaPozicija.zrno_nije1: A share, a stock or a security
pravnaPozicija.zrno_nije2: A unit of collective investment or an investment contract
pravnaPozicija.zrno_nije4: It carries no dividend, interest or yield
pravnaPozicija.zrno_nije5: It grants no right to a liquidation remainder
pravnaPozicija.zrno_nije6: It is not transferred to another user and is not inherited as a property right (art. 22, 34, 72)
pravnaPozicija.zasto_naslov: Why this is more than a statement
pravnaPozicija.zasto1_tekst: It cannot be given, sold or assigned to another user (art. 22). There is therefore no secondary market — no one to sell it to, at any price.
pravnaPozicija.zasto2_naslov: The dinar enters the Foundation, not the ledger
pravnaPozicija.zasto2_tekst: Donations in dinars do exist, and a donor's contribution is recorded in POEN — but these are two legally independent acts. Dinar funds enter the Foundation and do not enter the accounting framework of the system (art. 38). The recording is not consideration for the donation, there is no contract exchanging dinars for POEN, and a donor has no claim to have POEN recorded (art. 73). A donation is non-refundable.
pravnaPozicija.zasto3_naslov: The exit does not lead to money
pravnaPozicija.zasto3_tekst: Writing ZRNO off yields POEN, and POEN has no value outside the system and cannot be converted into money (art. 25). The exit leads into another internal entry, not outside.
pravnaPozicija.zasto4_naslov: The vote is not proportional to the stake
pravnaPozicija.zasto4_tekst: Voting power is the integer square root of the number of active ZRNO (art. 46). A hundred ZRNO give ten votes, not a hundred. The link between size and power is deliberately broken.
pravnaPozicija.zasto5_naslov: No inheritance, no claim on assets
pravnaPozicija.zasto5_tekst: POEN and ZRNO entries are not transferred and not inherited as property rights (art. 34, 72), and constitute no claim against the Foundation.
pravnaPozicija.zasto6_naslov: The coefficient is not an exchange rate
pravnaPozicija.zasto6_tekst: The accounting coefficient is the ratio between the total POEN recorded and the ZRNO available to be recorded. The Protocol computes it automatically and without discretion. It is not a price, not an exchange rate and not a performance index, and it expresses no value of ZRNO or POEN outside the system (art. 23). A change in a holder's standing is not a yield and is not guaranteed (art. 78).
pravnaPozicija.propisi_naslov: Why it falls outside those statutes
pravnaPozicija.propisi_uvod: The qualification does not rest on a declaration but on POEN and ZRNO failing the statutory definitions. Below is the test against each statute.
pravnaPozicija.zdi_tekst: The Act (art. 2) defines a digital asset as a digital record of value that can be transferred, stored or traded. POEN meets none of those three: it is not transferred, because it has no holder — a user does not hold it and does not hand it to anyone, but triggers an update of the Protocol's ledger; it cannot be stored outside the system; and it cannot be traded, because no secondary market exists.
pravnaPozicija.zps_tekst:
A payment transaction presupposes a transfer of monetary value between a payer and a payee. No such transfer occurs: POEN has neither monetary value nor a holder, so when a user initiates a re-registration, the Protocol changes its own database and nothing of monetary value changes hands.

Nor is POEN electronic money. The Act requires three cumulative conditions, and POEN meets none: it is not issued upon receipt of funds (it is recorded on the basis of a user's activity, and a donation to the Foundation and the recording of a contribution are legally separate acts), it does not serve to execute payment transactions, and it has no issuer in the legal sense.
pravnaPozicija.ztk_tekst: ZRNO is not a transferable security, because it is non-transferable — there is no transfer mechanism, no market and no possibility of trading. Nor is it a unit of collective investment, since it does not represent participation in a fund whose value depends on the assets the funds were invested in; ZRNO records a standing within an accounting system that has no asset value outside itself. POEN is not a financial instrument because it has no holder, is not transferred and cannot be converted into money. No participant invests funds expecting a financial return.
pravnaPozicija.sporno_uvod: Two features of the mechanics invite the question themselves. Both have been examined and both have an explicit answer.
pravnaPozicija.sporno1_tekst: Someone who donates dinars to the Foundation gets POEN recorded, which may bring them closer to the threshold for recording ZRNO. Three things break the reading of that chain as an investment contract: the donation is non-refundable and legally separate from the recording — a donor can neither condition it on the recording nor demand a refund; the donation is neither a necessary nor a privileged route to ZRNO — the same threshold of 20,000 POEN is reached through exchange, contribution and confirmations, without a single dinar; and the ratio between the donated amount and the number of POEN is not a fixed conversion rate but a system parameter.
pravnaPozicija.sporno2_naslov: Writing off at a higher coefficient
pravnaPozicija.sporno2_tekst: Someone who records ZRNO at a lower coefficient and writes it off at a higher one receives more POEN than they put in. Three things break the reading of that difference as a yield: the POEN received has no value outside the system — it cannot be converted, taken out or cashed in; the rise of the coefficient is not guaranteed and depends on the activity of the whole community, not on the efforts of third parties; and there is no issuer promising the rise and no institution paying out the difference. On top of that, whoever wants a vote must activate ZRNO and thereby loses the option to write it off — passive holding and governance exclude one another.
pravnaPozicija.principi_tekst: Every argument above rests on POEN having no value outside the system — and that holds only as long as no conversion mechanism exists. Non-convertibility is therefore the first of the four principles the legal position rests on (art. 70), together with the absence of property rights over the entries, the non-refundability of donations, and data minimisation. Those four are structural limits: they cannot be amended or abolished by any governance decision, including a decision of the Upper Circle. Breaching any of them changes the legal nature of the system.

kakoFunkcionisePage.sistem_hero_opis: You don't need to know any of this to start. This page covers the channels POEN comes from and how ZRNO works.
kakoFunkcionisePage.dublje_opis: The channels POEN comes from, what POEN is and what it isn't, how ZRNO is recorded and what the accounting coefficient is. None of it is needed to start.
kakoFunkcionisePage.meta_title: How KOLO works, step by step
kakoFunkcionisePage.meta_desc: How you enter KOLO, how it is confirmed that you are a real person, how POEN comes about and who decides on the rules. A detailed explanation of the whole system.
kakoFunkcionisePage.hero_opis: An explanation of the whole system. The shorter version is on the home page.
kakoFunkcionisePage.k1_opis: An email, a nickname and a password, and that is all. No ID card is needed, nor any other document. Throughout the interface others see you only under your nickname, while your real name, phone number and location are entered only if you decide to, and you can remove them at any time. Registration is free.
kakoFunkcionisePage.k2_naslov: What you can do straight away
kakoFunkcionisePage.k2_opis: You see the public record of exchanges and every listing on the Marketplace, with its content, price and place. You can post your first three listings and exchange, and POEN can be re-registered to you. Until you are confirmed you cannot re-register POEN to someone else yourself, post a request, or write to advertisers first. That is why the first step is usually your own listing, which someone already in the network responds to.
kakoFunkcionisePage.k3_naslov: Confirmation through the chain of confirmations
kakoFunkcionisePage.k3_opis:
A full member who knows you personally confirms that you are a real person. Through that confirmation you both enter the chain of confirmations, and the Protocol — the software that keeps the record — records 1,000 POEN for each of you.
Every confirmation raises your reality index by 10 per cent. You can receive ten confirmations in total, and you yourself can confirm anyone who is not already in your chain.
kakoFunkcionisePage.k4_opis: Now you have full access: you post listings without limit, ask for what you need, re-register POEN, contribute to the system and apply for the programmes. You too can bring in and confirm people you personally know.
kakoFunkcionisePage.k5_opis: ZRNO gives you the right to vote in the Upper Kolo, the body of ZRNO holders that decides on the rules applying to everyone. Votes are counted by square root, so no one with a lot of ZRNO can outvote the community on their own.
kakoFunkcionisePage.odgovornost_tekst: Whoever confirms someone who is not a real person loses those 1,000 POEN. For abuse they lose the right to confirm anyone further, and for a repeated one they may be excluded from the network. That is why a confirmation in KOLO is worth something.
kakoFunkcionisePage.evidencija_naslov: {broj} channels through which the Protocol records POEN in your ledger
kakoFunkcionisePage.poen_ne_kupuje: POEN is not bought for money.
kakoFunkcionisePage.poen_kanali: It is recorded through {broj} channels of contribution, under rules that are public and the same for everyone. For exchange, confirmation and donation the recording is automatic. For work for the community and for patronage, someone must first confirm that the work was done.
kakoFunkcionisePage.poen_preraspodela: When you exchange with someone, POEN is only re-registered from one to the other. Existing records are redistributed and nothing new comes into being.
kakoFunkcionisePage.n1_opis: Your first listing offering a good or a service — with a photograph, a description, a category and a place — brings you 1,000 POEN.
kakoFunkcionisePage.poen_uvod: POEN records what you have given to the community. It comes about only through contribution, through the {broj} channels listed above. It is what others in the network know you by when you need something yourself.
kakoFunkcionisePage.poen_jeste1: A record of what you have given to the community
kakoFunkcionisePage.poen_jeste2: It does not expire — your contribution is remembered for good
kakoFunkcionisePage.poen_jeste3: It is re-registered to someone else when you exchange
kakoFunkcionisePage.poen_jeste4: The basis on which ZRNO is recorded
kakoFunkcionisePage.poen_nije_uvod: In short: POEN is not money, it is not bought for dinars, and trading in it is forbidden by the Rulebook. The legal reasons are set out below.
kakoFunkcionisePage.poen_nije3: Digital assets or a cryptocurrency (Law on Digital Assets)
kakoFunkcionisePage.poen_nije4: A financial instrument or an investment scheme (Capital Markets Law)
kakoFunkcionisePage.poen_nije5: A claim against the Foundation or a property right of the user
kakoFunkcionisePage.poen_nije6: A thing existing outside the ledger — POEN is a record and nothing else
kakoFunkcionisePage.zerosum_naslov: How POEN comes about and how it moves
kakoFunkcionisePage.zerosum_tekst:
New POEN comes about only through the {broj} channels of contribution. Every time the Protocol records new POEN, it records the same amount against itself as a minus, so the sum of all records in the system — those of users and those of the Protocol — is always exactly zero.
In an exchange between people nothing new comes about. POEN is only re-registered from one to the other.
kakoFunkcionisePage.zrno_uvod: ZRNO gives you a vote in the Upper Kolo, the body that decides on KOLO's rules. Whoever contributes over a long time also gains a say in what the system looks like.
kakoFunkcionisePage.zrno_upis1: You record ZRNO yourself, on the basis of the POEN you have already gathered.
kakoFunkcionisePage.zrno_upis2: The total quantity of ZRNO is fixed at 1,000,000, and that number never changes.
kakoFunkcionisePage.zrno_upis3: How much POEN one ZRNO takes is set by the accounting coefficient, which rises as the amount of POEN in circulation rises.
kakoFunkcionisePage.zrno_upis4: ZRNO is not transferred between users. It stays with whoever recorded it.
kakoFunkcionisePage.zrno_koristi1: Active ZRNO gives you a vote in the Upper Kolo and cannot be written off while it is active.
kakoFunkcionisePage.zrno_koristi2: The number of votes is the square root of the number of active ZRNO. Someone with a hundred ZRNO has ten votes, not a hundred. That is why no one can outvote the community alone, however many they hold.
kakoFunkcionisePage.zrno_koristi4: You can hand your votes to another ZRNO holder — the votes only, never the ZRNO.
kakoFunkcionisePage.zrno_koristi5: Free ZRNO can be written off back to the Protocol, giving you POEN at the current coefficient.
kakoFunkcionisePage.koeficijent_naslov: The accounting coefficient is not an exchange rate
kakoFunkcionisePage.koeficijent_tekst:
The accounting coefficient is the ratio between the POEN recorded and the ZRNO available, and it says only how much POEN one ZRNO takes at a given moment. Since it rises as the network grows, whoever recorded ZRNO earlier receives more POEN on writing it off later than they gave for it — a recognition of those who held the system up while it was small.
This is not earnings. Writing off ZRNO gives you POEN, and POEN is not money, is not exchanged for dinars and does not leave the system. The coefficient is not a price and does not express the value of ZRNO outside KOLO.
kakoFunkcionisePage.cta_naslov: Now you know how it works
kakoFunkcionisePage.cta_opis: All that is left is to join. Registration takes about a minute, and right after it you can post your first three listings and see who is around you. Confirmation comes through your first exchange.

kakoFunkcionisePage.n7_opis: Recognition for the founders for what was invested before the system even existed: years of developing the concept and the documentation, building the platform, and the material costs they bore themselves, without a single dinar in compensation.
kakoFunkcionisePage.n6_opis:
You donate money to the Foundation, and the Protocol records POEN for you at a coefficient that rises with your total contribution.
POEN from a donation grants no ownership, does not turn into money and does not buy votes. A vote depends on ZRNO, and voting is quadratic, so a larger donor cannot outvote the community.
The terms are the same for everyone: the same table, the same thresholds, the same coefficients. An anonymous donation carries no POEN.
kakoFunkcionisePage.n5_opis:
A legal entity or a sole trader — a company, an association or a shop — signs a donation contract with the Foundation, in money, goods or services. The patron itself receives no POEN. The recognition is recorded for the owner who is a full member, or for the sole trader themselves, according to a table of seven levels.
The network needs money in order to run, and the terms of patronage are the same for every legal entity.
kakoFunkcionisePage.n4_opis: Programmes for mothers and carers, the elderly, special care and schooling, in which approved users have POEN recorded every day. This is not social assistance in the sense of the law and does not affect any entitlements you have from the state.
kakoFunkcionisePage.n3_opis: Concrete work for the community. ZRNO holders — in the first phase the Foundation's Management Board — publish a task, you apply and carry it out, then they confirm it was done, and only then is POEN recorded.
kakoFunkcionisePage.n2_opis: When a full member who knows you personally confirms you in the chain of confirmations, the Protocol records 1,000 POEN for you and 1,000 for them. When the confirmation is subject to oversight, 500 POEN goes to the overseer as well.
kakoFunkcionisePage.n8_opis: Children from the age of seven have their own space, separate from the rest of the system. A friendship is formed in person, by scanning a code, and 500 POINTS are recorded for each child — but only once at least one parent of each child is a regular member. Governed by the Rulebook on the Participation of Children.

dobrodosli.ekran1_p1: In KOLO people exchange work, goods and knowledge without money. What you give the community is recorded in POEN. POEN is not money: it cannot be bought, it cannot be exchanged for dinars, and outside the system it means nothing.
dobrodosli.ekran1_p2: POEN exists so that an exchange need not be simultaneous or mutual. You can help a neighbour today and find what you need from a third person a month later.
dobrodosli.ekran2_p1: Publish what you really have or know how to do. No attestation is needed for that, and you can have three active listings straight away. It does not have to be a trade or a profession: a lift into town, childcare, help in the garden, maths lessons, a bicycle repair, a surplus from the garden.
dobrodosli.ekran2_p2: A listing needs a title, a description, at least one photograph, a category and a place. For the first listing in which you offer something, 1,000 POEN is recorded for you as soon as the Foundation reviews and approves it.
dobrodosli.ekran3_p1: An attestation means that someone who knows you personally has stood behind the fact that you are a real person. It is the only check in KOLO. No documents or photographs are required.
dobrodosli.ekran3_p2: The attestation records 1,000 POEN for you and 1,000 for them, and everything else opens up for you: messages, the Chatroom, contact with advertisers, listings in which you ask for something, and applying to programmes. From that moment you can also attest to people you know.
dobrodosli.ekran3_p3: If you know someone already in KOLO, open Attestations and click “Show code”. You will get a QR code and a six-digit number. Show them the QR in person, or send the number in a message; they open the same page on their side, scan it or type it in, and the attestation succeeds.
dobrodosli.ekran3_p4: If you know no one, the attestation comes through your first exchange. Someone contacts you about a listing, you agree and meet. At that point the person has genuinely met you and, if they are a regular member themselves, they can attest to you. You may reply to a message before anyone has attested to you; you simply cannot start a conversation first.
dobrodosli.ekran4_p1: While you wait for the first contact, set up your profile. Add a picture, enter your place and a few words about yourself or about what you do. For each field you choose whether others can see it. Your real name and phone number are optional and you can remove them whenever you like.
dobrodosli.ekran4_p2: All the pages are in the menu, on the left on a computer and under ☰ on a phone. Foundation news and the Chatroom are on the Home page, your POEN record is under “POEN”, and answers to every question are on the Questions page. You can reopen this guide at any time, from the ? sign at the top of the page.
dobrodosli.ekran4_p3: If you have a child over seven, you can open an account for them from your profile. Children have their own separate space: they befriend one another, collect POEN and exchange it. Adult members cannot reach their profile, and you can allow communication for the purpose of an exchange.
dobrodosli.dete1_p1: Children’s KOLO is where children exchange things, help and knowledge among themselves, without money. Adults have no access to children’s KOLO unless your parent allows it.
dobrodosli.dete1_p2: In children’s KOLO, POEN is recorded for you for the friendships you make. POEN is not money and cannot be bought. With POEN you can get something from another child, and for what you give them you receive POEN.
dobrodosli.dete1_p3: For everything to work, your mum or dad has to approve your account. We sent them a message to the email you entered. If they did not get it, read them the six-digit number from your screen — they enter it with your name.
dobrodosli.dete1_p4: While you wait, you can set up your profile and collect friends. As soon as they approve the account, the Chatroom, ads and messages open up. POEN arrives once someone who knows them in person attests to them.
dobrodosli.dete2_p1: Create a listing for what you have or know how to do. Comics you have finished, a toy you no longer need, help with maths homework, drawing, walking a dog.
dobrodosli.dete2_p2: A listing needs a title, a description, at least one picture, a category and a place. Other children in KOLO see your listings. Adults do not see them until your parent allows communication with them.
dobrodosli.dete2_p3: When someone wants what you offer, they will contact you and transfer POEN to you. You receive POEN from friendships and from exchanges with other children.
dobrodosli.dete3_p1: Every friendship brings 500 POEN to you and 500 to them. There is no limit on the number of friends.
dobrodosli.dete3_p2: A friendship is made in person only. Open Friends, press “Show code” and let your friend scan it with their phone. The code lasts five minutes, so you have to stand next to each other.
dobrodosli.dete3_p3: You both get POEN once both accounts are ready: your parent and theirs have approved the account and become regular members. Until then both of you see “500 waiting”. You can be friends with your own brother or sister, but that carries no POEN.
dobrodosli.dete3_p4: In the Chatroom you see messages from your friends. What you write is seen only by those you are friends with.
dobrodosli.dete4_naslov: Profile, POEN and what to do with it
dobrodosli.dete4_p1: Set up your profile and pick the school you go to. That way you see how many children from your school are in KOLO and where you stand on the list.
dobrodosli.dete4_p2: You see your POEN under “POEN”. It shows how much you have and where it came from. Your parent can transfer their POEN to you, and you can transfer yours to them.
dobrodosli.dete4_p3: You spend POEN by agreeing with another child and re-registering it to them for something you need. You give POEN, they give the thing or the help.
dobrodosli.ekran1_p3: The next two screens explain what opens everything else for you: a listing in which you offer something, and an attestation from someone who knows you.

admin.korisnici_lazni_confirm:
Establish that no real person stands behind this account?

Every attestation the account touches falls — both those it gave and those it received. Each affected member loses 10 percentage points of their reality index and regains a slot in the chain; their other attestations remain in force. The recorded POEN (1,000 / 1,000 / 500) is written back to the Protocol, and any uncovered part passes as compensation onto the record of whoever gave the attestation. The account itself drops to a 0% index and is excluded.

Return the account “{pseudonim}” to its registration day?

Irreversible: every confirmation the account touches falls (including those it gave others, along with the POEN recorded then), POEN and ZRNO go to zero, and listings, conversations, notifications, history and consents to the acts are deleted. The email, password and pseudonym remain — signing in works with the same details.

All POEN the Protocol recorded to this account is reversed (the record may go negative; POEN others re-registered to it remains), every confirmation the account touches falls — so people credited for them may also go negative — ZRNO is written off and programme applications are closed. admin.doprinos_zatecene_opis: The action runs in three steps. First, the contribution is recorded retroactively for members who have a qualifying listing but no record at all — the record is lost if publishing breaks halfway. Then, regular members whose 1,000 POEN contribution is noted but not yet recorded have it recorded now (Art. 40a, transitional paragraph); members without an attestation are skipped, as you approve those one by one in the First listings tab. Finally, notice goes out to those whose contribution was recorded but who were never told.
admin.doprinos_zatecene_napomena: The total POEN jumps by 1,000 × the number resolved. Since a founding step is recorded automatically at every 100,000 POEN, the first nightly run after this may trigger a step. Running it again does not record twice.

deca.podnaslov: You open a child's account from your own. You answer for what they publish.
deca.potvrda_isteklo: {broj} confirmation(s) lapsed because no one responded
deca.potvrda_gotova: The child's existence has been confirmed
deca.obavestenje_naslov: Before you enter anything about the child
deca.obavestenje_1: Only the child's pseudonym and date of birth are recorded. Nothing else.
deca.obavestenje_2: You give consent once. You do not approve each of the child's actions.
deca.obavestenje_3: You do not see the child's messages. You see their profile, exchanges and listings, and you may remove any listing.
deca.obavestenje_4: You are answerable for everything the child publishes until you remove it.
deca.obavestenje_posledica: The people who confirmed your reality will be asked to confirm that you have a child of that age. Anyone who does not respond within 30 days loses their confirmation of your reality — and your index falls as a result.
deca.dugme_otvori: Open the account and send for confirmation
deca.polje_datum_upozorenje: The date cannot be changed once the account is open.
deca.polje_lozinka_opis: The child signs in with the PSEUDONYM and this password, on the same page as everyone else. There is no e-mail.
deca.greska_slanje: That did not work. Try again.
deca.prekidac_naslov: Allow communication and exchange with adult members
deca.prekidac_opis: While it is off, the child talks and exchanges only with other children. It can be switched off at any moment.
deca.oglasi_prazno: The child has not published any listing yet.
deca.oglasi_napomena: You can remove listings. You do not see or remove messages.
deca.potvrdi_uklanjanje: Remove this listing from the Marketplace?
deca.brisanje_posledica: Deleting writes off all of the child's POEN and removes all of their listings. This cannot be undone.
deca.potvrde_opis: Someone you confirmed has opened an account for their child. You have {dana} days to respond.
deca.pitanje_opis: You are responding from what you yourself know about {pseudonim}. The child's details are not shown to you.
deca.ako_ne_znas: If you have no knowledge of this, don't press either button. But be aware: if you don't respond in time, your confirmation of that person will be cancelled, the POEN recorded for it written off, and your slot freed.
deca.pseudonim_pravilo: Pseudonym: 3–30 characters, Latin letters (a–z), digits and _ . - only — no spaces and no č, ć, š, ž, đ. It may not start or end with a separator.
deca.razgovori_opis: You see what the child writes and who writes to them. You cannot join the conversation — the other side is someone else's child.
deca.uvid_obavestenje: Your mum and dad do not read what you write to friends. They only see who you write with. If you write with an adult — they read that.
deca.poziv_predlog: The child {pseudonim} gave your address as the parent's address.
deca.preuzmi_opis: Enter the child's pseudonym and the six-digit code from their screen. The second parent uses the same path.
deca.polje_datum_preuzimanje_opis: If the account already has a date, leave this empty — the date cannot be changed once entered.
deca.pregled_opis: The content of conversations between children is not shown — only with whom and how much.
deca.polje_datum_raspon: Enter the child's date of birth — the child must be between 7 and 18 years old.
deca.lozinka_opis: A child account has no e-mail address, so the child cannot request a new password. You set it here.
deca.lozinka_pravilo: At least {broj} characters. Write it down and tell your child.
deca.lozinka_uspeh: The password is set. Tell your child what it is.

decjaPocetna.oglasi_prazno: No ads yet. Make the first one — say what you are offering!
decjaPocetna.pricaonica_prazno: Your friends write here. Scan someone's code next to you and you will see their messages too.
decjaPocetna.greska_slanje: That did not work. Try again.
decjaPocetna.ceka_naslov: Still waiting for a parent to approve
decjaPocetna.ceka_opis: Once your mum or dad approves your account, you can write to your friends. {broj, plural, =0 {} one {One friend is already waiting for you.} other {# friends are already waiting for you.}}
decjaPocetna.ceka_uputstvo: Show your mum or dad the message we sent them. If it did not arrive, read them this number out loud.
decjaPocetna.kod_naslov: Number for your mum or dad
decjaPocetna.kod_profil_opis: Read this number out to your mum or dad. They enter it with your name.

prijatelji.kod_uputstvo: Let your friend scan it with their phone. The code stops working quickly, so stand next to each other.
prijatelji.skeniraj_opis: Scan the code your friend is showing you.
prijatelji.spisak_prazno: No friends yet. Show your code to someone next to you.
prijatelji.greska_slanje: That did not work. Try again.
prijatelji.na_cekanju: {iznos} POEN is waiting for you. It arrives once your friends are approved too.
prijatelji.raskid_potvrda: Stop being friends with {pseudonim}? You will also stop writing to each other.
prijatelji.raskid_potvrda_poen: Stop being friends with {pseudonim}? You will each lose 500 POEN — you and them — and you will stop writing to each other.
prijatelji.oznaka_ceka_mene: 500 waiting — you are not approved yet
prijatelji.oznaka_ceka_oboje: 500 waiting — neither of you is approved yet

registracijaDeteta.podnaslov: Pick a name and a password. Enter your mum's or dad's email — we will send them a message to approve your account.
registracijaDeteta.pseudonim_opis: Others see this name. No spaces and no accents. Numbers, a dash and a dot are fine.
registracijaDeteta.email_roditelja_opis: We send them one message to approve your account. Ask them today — without approval the account only works for 14 days.
registracijaDeteta.greska: The account was not created. Try again.
registracijaDeteta.uspeh_opis: We sent a message to {email}. While you wait, you can collect friends.
registracijaDeteta.kod_naslov: Number for your mum or dad
registracijaDeteta.kod_opis: If the message does not arrive, your mum or dad enter your name and this number.

detePoziv.opis: An account under the name {pseudonim} has given your address as a parent's address.
detePoziv.datum_opis: The date cannot be changed once entered. With it you give consent for the child's participation.
detePoziv.nije_moje_uvod: If this is not your child:
detePoziv.potvrda_brisanja: The account and all its data will be deleted. Continue?
detePoziv.istekao: The link has expired. Ask the child to read you the six-digit code from their screen and enter it in the “My children” section.
detePoziv.greska: The action was not carried out. Try again.
detePoziv.vec_preuzet_naslov: The account is already taken over
detePoziv.vec_preuzet_opis: The account {pseudonim} already has a parent. If you are the second parent, enter the pseudonym and the code in the “My children” section.
detePoziv.ishod_preuzet_opis: The child can now enter the Chat room. POEN from friendships is noted and is recorded once you become a regular member — once someone who knows you confirms you.
detePoziv.ishod_odbijen_opis: We will not send you any more messages about this account. If nobody takes it over, it deletes itself.
detePoziv.ishod_obrisan_opis: The account and all data have been removed.
detePoziv.datum_raspon: Enter the child's date of birth — the child must be between 7 and 18 years old.
detePoziv.nisam_clan_naslov: If you are not on KOLO yet
detePoziv.nisam_clan_korak1: 1. Open your own account — it's free and it brings you back to this page.
detePoziv.nisam_clan_korak2: 2. Take over the child's account and enter the date of birth.
detePoziv.nisam_clan_korak3: 3. Ask someone who knows you and is already a member to confirm that you are a real person.
detePoziv.nisam_clan_poen: The child uses the platform as soon as you take the account over. Their POEN is recorded once you become a regular member — nothing is lost, it all stays noted and is recorded to them on that day.
detePoziv.dobijate: By taking over you gain insight into your child's friends and listings, the switch for conversations with adults, and the ability to set a new password for them. You do not see the content of conversations with other children.

skole.lista_broj_opis: How many children from the school take part.
skole.lista_procenat_opis: What share of the school takes part. Here even a small school can come first in the country.
skole.bez_broja_ucenika: The number of enrolled pupils is not known.
skole.napomena: The list shows schools with at least one participating child. Only children with at least one parent who is a full member are counted.
skole.spisak_prazan: The list of schools has not been entered yet.
skole.nema_skola: No school has a participating child yet.
skole.deca_prazno: No children from this school yet.
skole.izbor_opis: Choose the school you attend. The national school ranking is built from these choices.
skole.izbor_placeholder: Type the school name or town
skole.izbor_rok: You can change your school once every 30 days.
skole.kartica_bez_skole: You have not chosen a school. Choose it and see where you stand in Serbia.
skole.kartica_nije_na_listi: Your school is not on the list yet — it joins with its first participating child.
skole.deca_samo_deca: Only children see the list of children from this school. The numbers and the ranking are visible to everyone.

emailDeteta.opis: If you have your own e-mail address, enter it. It is used for one thing only: so you can set a new password if you forget yours.
emailDeteta.poslato: We sent a message to {email}. Open it and confirm the address.
emailDeteta.ceka_potvrdu: The address {email} is waiting to be confirmed. Open the message we sent to it.
emailDeteta.napomena: We do not send notifications to it. If you have no address of your own, your parent sets your new password.
emailDeteta.greska: That did not work. Try again.

potvrdiEmail.podnaslov: One more click and the address is saved.
potvrdiEmail.podnaslov_gotovo: The address is saved to your account.
potvrdiEmail.objasnjenje: This address was entered on a KOLO account. Confirm it so you can set a new password if you forget yours.
potvrdiEmail.nisi_ti: If this was not you, close this page. Without confirmation the address is not saved anywhere.
potvrdiEmail.cemu_sluzi: If you forget your password, we send a link for a new one to this address. We do not send notifications.
potvrdiEmail.greska: The link is not valid or has expired. Enter the address again in your profile.

nabavke.uvod: Through collective procurement we provide goods our members do not produce.
nabavke.predlog_opis: Suggest what the next collective procurement should be.
nabavke.moja_POZVAN: You are invited — confirm your collection day.
nabavke.moja_POTVRDIO: Confirmed — you have a collection code.
nabavke.moja_ISTEKAO: The response period expired — the place went to the next in the order.
nabavke.moja_NIJE_PREUZEO: The share was not collected on the day entered. Your POEN has been released.
nabavke.registar_prazan: The register is empty. Submit the first proposal.
nabavke.pravni_osnov: Rulebook on Projects and Collective Procurement, Art. 9–32.
nabavke.prijava_opis: Applications are open until {rok}. Applying does not touch your record — the obligation arises only when you confirm a collection day.
nabavke.prijave_zatvorene: Applications for this procurement are closed.
nabavke.cekas_mesto: You have applied — {mesto} in the order. An invitation arrives when your turn comes.
nabavke.cekas_red: You have applied. The order is established once applications close.
nabavke.pozvan: You are in — place {mesto}. Your share costs {poen} POEN.
nabavke.pozvan_uputstvo: Choose the day you are coming for the goods. Only then is the POEN reserved.
nabavke.kod_uputstvo: Show this code at the supplier. POEN is annulled upon collection, not before.
nabavke.preuzeto: You have collected your share. {poen} POEN was annulled.
nabavke.paritet_napomena: The POEN per unit equals the retail reference price, one to one. POEN is not exchanged for goods and does not reach the supplier — the goods were bought with dinars, while POEN is annulled as a record of participation that has been used.
nabavke.ponude_opis: All are published, including those not selected.
nabavke.preuzeli_napomena: The pseudonym and position in the order are shown. The number of POEN in the record is not published.
